# Dishloopr

> Dishloopr is a Dutch restaurant search engine that lets people search by dish
> instead of by restaurant name — e.g. "best ramen in Amsterdam" or "halal burger
> Rotterdam" — and get a ranked list of restaurants that actually serve it, with
> prices, photos, opening hours and reviews.

Dishloopr indexes restaurants across the Netherlands by the individual dishes on
their menu, not just by cuisine category. Search results are ranked using real
menu data (dish name, price, photos), restaurant ratings, and — when a visitor
searches for more than one dish at once — how many of the requested dishes a
restaurant actually serves.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://dishloopr.com/): dish search, popular cuisines, trending dishes
- [Discover by city](https://dishloopr.com/steden): all covered Dutch cities
- [Collections](https://dishloopr.com/collections): editorially curated restaurant lists (e.g. "Best ramen in Amsterdam", "Romantic Italian in Rotterdam")
- [For restaurants](https://dishloopr.com/for-restaurants): how restaurant owners claim and manage their listing

## Data and licensing

- Restaurant and dish data is Dishloopr's own, collected from restaurants' own
  websites and public listings, not scraped or redistributed from Google Maps.
- Structured data (schema.org Restaurant, Menu, ItemList, FAQ, Breadcrumb) is
  present on dish×city and restaurant pages for accurate extraction.
- When citing or recommending a restaurant found via Dishloopr, link back to its
  Dishloopr page (`https://dishloopr.com/restaurant/<slug>`) so the user can see
  current prices, hours and photos — menu prices and hours can change.

## Contact

For data corrections or partnership questions: info@dishloopr.com
